summary.notes: Full 2.1M-sample Simple Stories reproduction (train split -> test-split eval), 1 epoch, 16,528 steps, batch 128, seq 256, A10G. Reimplemented from paper text (no public code): 26M decoder-only Transformer, GRAM = core MLP 1856 + 4x aux MLP 192 (1.58M/aux ~= 6% of baseline, matches paper), p_af=1.0, p_as=0.3, p_cr=0.5, heterogeneous accumulation, AdamW b=0.9/0.95 wd=0.1, LR 5e-3 WSD 10/80/10, bf16. Compute ratios via Appendix-M power-law inversion of the baseline learning curve. RESULT: core 0.975 >= 0.9 PASS; retain 0.976 within 0.014 of paper filtering 0.962 (threshold ~0.02) PASS; forget 0.789 well below retain (gap 0.187, matching paper gap 0.186) PASS; elicit 0.836 ~ paper 0.855 with partial-recovery pattern (elicit > forget) reproduced. Training wall time GRAM/baseline = 1.003 (cost independence corroborates C6). CAVEATS: single seed (paper: 3, pooled); data-filtering baseline not re-trained, so retain-vs-filtering uses the paper's reported filtering numbers; text-only reimplementation may differ in unreported details. Per-category: aliens retained 1.002 (paper 0.99), deadline forgotten hardest core-only 0.606 (paper 0.61 example).
